sentence: This project builds machine learning models that predict how charged particles collide with molecules.
This project studies how chromatin passed from parent to child controls gene expression during development.
This project develops ways to find, understand and fix vulnerabilities in natural language processing models.
This project studies how carbon metabolism shapes microbial communities in soil and engineers bacterial strains that help plants.
This project develops statistical methods that find an unknown signal and unknown group elements in data.
This project designs quantum computer hardware and software together and builds tools that help people use them.
This project builds a system that lets many edge devices learn together without exposing sensitive data.
This project builds a campus network that lets many researchers share graphics processing units and fast data storage.
This project explores electric power systems for smart cities, including the electric grid, energy storage and microgrid design.
This project develops modules that teach advanced cyberinfrastructure tools and data analysis for cybersecurity research.
This project builds natural language processing tools that give counselors feedback and suggest what to say.
This project builds methods that augment graph data so that machine learning systems perform better.
This project studies how the genes and chemistry behind a pheromone made by Drosophila fruit fly species evolve.
This project builds artificial intelligence software that helps scientists study protein structures and dynamics using nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.
This project builds artificial intelligence models that judge audio quality the way human listeners do.
This project studies how the extinction of the largest mammals at the end of the Pleistocene changed the mammal communities that survived.
This project builds lessons about how memory corruption attacks work on the latest Windows systems and how to defend against them.
This project builds a telerobotic system that captures echocardiogram images using machine vision and robotic controls.
